violation_type.title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Date (26 TAC §747.1327(b)(2))
violation_type.typical_finding: Training certificates provided did not have a date of completions.

finding_variants.text: Training certificates provided did not have a date of completions.

The primary caregiver has annual training certificates that are missing the date of completion for:  Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.  Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction.  Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma;   Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS); and  Understanding early childhood brain development.
